---
title: "Who sponsors Russian war machine?"
description: "Russia's pivot to China and India after sanctions boosted export revenue short-term, but left the war economy dangerously concentrated on two buyers."
date: "2024-03-18"
categories: [ukraine, russia-economy]
---

Western sanctions pushed Russia's trade eastward, and the immediate effect
was higher energy export revenue — but at the cost of extreme customer
concentration in just two markets, China and India. India in particular
emerges as an unexpected financier of the Russian war effort, increasing
imports of Russian goods by $53 billion between 2021 and 2023. That
concentration is a vulnerability as much as a lifeline: Russia keeps the
revenue flowing but is now exposed to whatever these two buyers decide next.

**Originally published on Substack**, March 18, 2024.
